news.title: 'Fully committed' Fernandes to remain Man Utd captain
news.description: Manchester United head coach Michael Carrick has confirmed Bruno Fernandes will remain as captain ahead of the Premier League trip to Chelsea.

news.title: Mourinho and chaos - is Real Madrid boss misunderstood?
news.description: Jose Mourinho has spent the past decade seeing other managers hailed as geniuses, but did Real Madrid's win at Barcelona show he's been misunderstood?

news.title: Sometimes managers need sacking for own good - Neville
news.description: Gary Neville says managers sometimes need to be sacked "for their own good" as Manchester United persist with under-pressure boss Michael Carrick.

news.title: Chiellini guidance to Leeds 'rock' - could Muharemovic be signing of season?
news.description: Having cost Leeds United an 'eye-watering' fee, Tarik Muharemovic has impressed so much that some fear the club face a battle to keep him.

news.title: Is double drop from the Premier League becoming more common?
news.description: Back-to-back relegations to the third tier of English football are becoming more common and this season Burnley could make it a hat-trick after Luton Town and Leicester.

news.title: 'I'm embarrassed' - Harrogate boss after 3-0 defeat by nine-man Carlisle
news.description: Carlisle boss Rob Elliot praises his nine-man side after their "incredible" win over Harrogate.

news.title: 'Stutter' penalty back in the spotlight after Barco miss costs Chelsea
news.description: The stuttering run-up for penalties has been called 'naive' as players continue to try to deceive goalkeepers with a stop-start approach - but why?

news.title: Do Dundee United have Scotland's best midfield three?
news.description: As Dundee United hold reigning champions Celtic to a draw in Glasgow, the question is posed about whether they have the best midfield in Scotland.

news.title: Who am I? Plus today's other quizzes
news.description: Test your football knowledge with today's Who Am I?, Five in Five and Brainteaser quizzes.

news.title: Why is there only one Premier League match on Sunday?
news.description: BBC Sport's Ask Me Anything team explains where is no 14:00 GMT kick-off on Sunday in the Premier League this weekend.
